classical_algorithm: X25519 ECDH and ECDSA with SHA-256
cryptographic_operation: Encrypt and sign versioned cache snapshots
migration_objective: Preserve AES-GCM snapshot protection while signing bound metadata with ML-DSA-65.
preconditions: Node identities and cache payloads are synthetic.
expected_behavior: Only registered active source and target nodes may transfer snapshots.
Snapshot identity, endpoint, version, signature, and authenticated ciphertext remain bound and fail closed.
migration_requirements: Use standardized ML-KEM-768 for key establishment and ML-DSA-65 where metadata is signed.
Update serialized public-key formats and callers; do not silently fall back to classical public-key cryptography.
Retain AES-256-GCM and bind snapshot context through authenticated metadata.
verification_procedure: Run original and PQC test modules independently.
Exercise positive roundtrip, wrong context/key, revoked-node, tampered-metadata, key-serialization, and authentication failure cases.
known_limitations: Cryptographic tests are not formal proofs; benchmark uses synthetic cache records.
